Waikato Regional Council

Kia ora, how can we help?

News Rates Flood Room Environmental data Request information or report an issue Have your say Public transport Council meetings and workshops
LOCAL GOVERNMENT REFORM: The Government's Simplifying Local Government reform programme aims to build a simpler, more efficient local government system, reducing the number of councils across New Zealand through the creation of unitary authorities.
2026/27 MAHERE Ā-TAU ANNUAL PLAN: Our 2026/27 Annual Plan was adopted by the council on 25 June 2026. Learn more about our proposed finances and activities from 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027.
COME HIGH WATER: Do you know how flood schemes work, what you’re protected against (and not), and what you can do to stay safe and protect your property?
PC1 DECISION: The Environment Court has directed Waikato Regional Council to make a final 20 specific changes to proposed Waikato Regional Plan Change 1 (PC1). The decision was issued by the court on Monday, 8 June 2026, giving the council until 21 July to make the changes.
SHAPING OUR COUNCIL, OUR REGION: Our Strategic Direction 2026-2036 sets a clear direction for the next decade with a focus on delivery for the period 2026-2029.
